items.raw_excerpt: A 300-year-old pub which is the only one in a York village could be granted protected status under a bid lodged with the city council.
items.summary_en: A 300-year-old pub is the only one left in a York village. A bid has been made to give it special protected status. The city council is reviewing the request.
items.summary_ko: 요크의 한 마을에 남은 유일한 펍이 300년의 역사를 자랑한다. 이 펍을 특별 보호 대상으로 지정해 달라는 신청이 시의회에 접수됐다.
items.title_en: Old pub in York village may get protected status
items.title_ko: 요크 마을 마지막 남은 300년 된 펍, 보호 대상 될 듯
items.title_original: Historic pub which is last one in Yorkshire village could get protected status - Yorkshire Post

items.raw_excerpt: Customers claim they are being sold cars that break down within weeks.
items.summary_en: A car seller is facing many complaints from customers. People say the cars break down within weeks of buying them. The number of complaints has gone up sharply.
items.summary_ko: 한 자동차 판매업체가 불량 차량을 판매한다는 고객 불만이 급증하고 있다. 구매한 지 몇 주 만에 차가 고장 난다는 주장이 잇따르고 있다.
items.title_en: Complaints soar over car seller's faulty motors
items.title_ko: 고장난 차를 파는 자동차 판매업체에 항의 빗발쳐
items.title_original: Complaints soar over car seller's 'faulty' motors

items.raw_excerpt: A ban on under-18s using e-scooters will be discussed by Cabinet today.
items.summary_en: The Irish Cabinet will discuss a proposal to ban people under 18 from using e-scooters. The new rules would affect young riders across the country.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드 내각이 18세 미만 청소년의 전동킥보드 사용을 금지하는 안건을 논의할 예정이다. 이번 규제는 전국적으로 청소년 운행자에게 영향을 미칠 전망이다.
items.title_en: Ireland to consider banning under-18s from e-scooters

items.raw_excerpt: Upper Hutt's mayor is urging other Wellington councils not to force it into amalgamating against its will.
items.summary_en: The mayor of Upper Hutt is asking nearby Wellington-area councils not to push the city into merging against its will. She says forced amalgamation would harm the local community and its identity.
items.summary_ko: 어퍼헛 시장이 웰링턴 지역 인근 의회들에게 도시를 강제로 통합하지 말아 달라고 요청했다. 그녀는 강제 통합이 지역 공동체와 정체성을 해칠 것이라고 말했다.
items.title_en: Upper Hutt mayor tells Wellington councils not to force amalgamation
items.title_ko: 어퍼헛 시장, 웰링턴 의회들에 '강제 통합하지 말라' 촉구
items.title_original: Upper Hutt mayor: Don't force us to amalgamate with Wellington councils

items.raw_excerpt: Dublin Bus has launched a driver recruitment campaign targeted at women looking for flexible or part-time work.
items.summary_en: Dublin Bus has started a recruitment campaign to bring in more women drivers. The new ads target women who want flexible or part-time work hours.
items.summary_ko: 더블린 버스가 여성 운전기사 채용을 늘리기 위한 캠페인을 시작했다. 새 광고는 유연 근무나 시간제 근무를 원하는 여성을 대상으로 한다.
items.title_en: Dublin Bus offers part-time hours to attract women drivers
items.title_ko: 더블린 버스, 여성 운전기사 유치 위해 시간제 근무 제안
items.title_original: Dublin Bus offering part-time hours to draw women drivers

items.raw_excerpt: Bei einem in der Nacht entlaufenen Wildtier im Süden von Berlin könnte es sich nach Angaben der Polizei um eine Löwin handeln. Anrainer wurden vor dem Verlassen ihrer Wohnung gewarnt.
items.summary_en: Police in southern Berlin warn residents that a wild animal that escaped during the night could be a lioness. People are told not to leave their apartments.
items.summary_ko: 베를린 남부에서 밤사이 탈출한 야생 동물이 암사자일 수 있다고 경찰이 경고했습니다. 주민들은 집 밖으로 나가지 말라는 주의를 받았습니다.
items.title_en: Warning to residents: Lion may have escaped in Berlin
items.title_ko: 베를린에서 사자 탈출 가능성, 주민 경고
items.title_original: Warnung an Bewohner: Löwe könnte in Berlin entlaufen sein - vienna.at

items.raw_excerpt: The Stratford school celebrated its 130th birthday with a trip to a historical village.
items.summary_en: A school in Stratford marked its 130th birthday by visiting a historical village. Students explored the Taranaki Pioneer Village for the celebration.
items.summary_ko: 스트랫퍼드의 한 학교가 개교 130주년을 맞아 역사 마을로 견학을 떠났습니다. 학생들은 타라나키 파이어니어 빌리지에서 축하 행사를 가졌습니다.
items.title_en: Stratford school turns 130, celebrates with village trip
items.title_ko: 스트랫퍼드 학교 개교 130주년 마을 여행으로 축하
items.title_original: 130th birthday for Stratford school - NZ Herald

items.raw_excerpt: Austria’s e-card can now be used on a smartphone, which means you no longer have to carry the plastic card everywhere with you if you would rather keep it digital.
items.summary_en: Austria's e-card for health insurance can now be used on a smartphone. People no longer need to carry the plastic card. The digital version works the same way as the physical card.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아의 건강보험 전자카드(e-card)를 이제 스마트폰에서 사용할 수 있다. 플라스틱 카드를 항상 지니고 다닐 필요가 없어졌다. 디지털 카드는 기존 실물 카드와 동일하게 작동한다.
items.title_en: Austria puts health e-card on smartphones
items.title_ko: 오스트리아 건강보험 전자카드, 이제 스마트폰으로 사용 가능
items.title_original: How to add your Austrian e-card to your phone

items.raw_excerpt: DEMAWUSA begins three-day sit-in protest at the City of Johannesburg's political offices.
items.summary_en: DEMAWUSA union workers began a three-day sit-in protest at the City of Johannesburg political offices. They demand the city end its use of outsourced labor. Workers want direct city employment instead of contractor jobs.
items.summary_ko: DEMAWUSA 노동조합이 요하네스버그 시청 청사에서 3일간의 연좌 농성에 돌입했다. 조합원들은 시가 외주 용역을 중단하고 직접 고용으로 전환할 것을 요구하고 있다.
items.title_en: Union starts sit-in protest at Johannesburg offices
items.title_ko: 요하네스버그 시청에서 연좌 농성 시작한 노동조합
items.title_original: DEMAWUSA starts Joburg sit-in, demands end to outsourcing

items.raw_excerpt: "Si algún fin de semana no tengo guardia quiero bajar a ver a mi familia, a mi pareja y a mis amigos, pues son tres horas en coche; tampoco está lejos", relata. Más información: Ana regenta la farmacia más antigua de Albacete con solo 25 años: "Los dueños anteriores confiaron mucho en mí"
items.summary_en: Nahum left Valencia for a small town with only 130 residents. He says rent is three times cheaper, which lets him save money. The town is a three-hour drive from his family and partner.
items.summary_ko: 나움은 발렌시아를 떠나 인구 130명의 작은 마을로 이사했다. 월세가 3분의 1로 줄어 저축이 가능해졌다고 말한다. 가족과 연인이 사는 곳까지는 차로 3시간 거리라고 한다.
items.title_en: He moved to a village of 130 people: 'Rent is three times less, I can save'
items.title_ko: 인구 130명 마을로 이사한 청년 "월세가 3분의 1, 저축할 수 있어요"
items.title_original: Nahum se mudó a un pueblo de 130 habitantes tras dejar Valencia: "El alquiler es tres veces menos, puedo ahorrar" - El Español

items.raw_excerpt: The national heat plan has been activated for the second time this summer as temperatures are set to reach between 30C and 35C in most parts of the Netherlands. The meteorological office KNMI has issued code yellow warnings for the inland provinces of Overijssel, Gelderland, Noord-Brabant and Limburg, for Wednesday, and Thursday and Friday. Temperatures are due to peak at 35C on Wednesday before falling slightly to around 32C on Thursday. On Saturday there will be a brief respite, with...
items.summary_en: The Dutch national heat plan is active for the second time this summer. Temperatures will reach 35C in inland provinces. Code yellow weather warnings have been issued for the middle of the week.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드에서 올여름 두 번째로 국가 폭염 대책이 발동됐다. 내륙 지방의 낮 기온이 35도까지 오르며 주중에 노란색 주의보가 내려졌다.
items.title_en: Heat wave hits Netherlands with temperatures up to 35C
items.title_original: Weather warnings issued as temperatures set to hit 35C

items.raw_excerpt: Bad weather, more competition and high ticket prices have hit some of southern Finland's festivals while events in the north continue to thrive.
items.summary_en: Bad weather, strong competition, and high ticket prices are hurting music festivals in southern Finland. But festivals in the north continue to attract big crowds. Northern events benefit from less competition and audiences used to traveling long distances.
items.summary_ko: 악천후와 치열한 경쟁, 높은 티켓 가격이 핀란드 남부의 음악 페스티벌에 타격을 주고 있다. 그러나 북부 지역 축제들은 계속해서 큰 관객을 끌어모으고 있다. 북부는 경쟁이 적고 장거리 이동에 익숙한 관객 덕분에 유리한 상황이다.
items.title_en: Some Finnish music festivals struggle while others thrive
items.title_ko: 핀란드 음악 페스티벌, 남부는 부진 북부는 호황
items.title_original: Some Finnish music festivals flounder while others draw huge crowds

items.raw_excerpt: Spain's PM reacts to Gaza girl's video of mural dedicated to him, Valencia creates committee to help tourists in emergencies, Cucurella gets tattoo of Spanish coach's face after World Cup win, and more news from Spain this Wednesday July 29th.
items.summary_en: Spain soccer player Cucurella got a tattoo of the team coach's face. He did it after Spain won the World Cup.

items.title_en: Soccer star Cucurella tattoos coach's face after World Cup win
